content.title: Rainy-Night Chase | Street Fight to Motorcycle Escape
content.summary: The chase first establishes its direction, uses one close-range interception to change the rhythm, then transfers the subject from running on foot to a faster vehicle and sustains the escape axis.

quick_start.input_format: Chased subject + single pursuit axis + one compact interception + immediate on-foot-to-vehicle handoff + continuous acceleration ending
quick_start.recommended_input: A research courier crosses salt flats while two survey vehicles pursue along one axis. In a narrow trench, the courier disables one clamp arm with a single counter-move, immediately steps onto a sand skiff, and keeps accelerating in the established direction.
required_anchors: Establish one readable pursuit axis before any combat begins.
Use one narrow threshold to compress the lead and the threat.
Complete an immediate, visible foot-to-faster-carrier handoff after the encounter.
End with sustained carrier acceleration along the established travel direction.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Chase scenes that establish one travel axis, use a single close-range interception to change rhythm, then transfer the subject from running on foot to a faster vehicle and sustain the escape axis.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish a readable pursuit corridor, interrupt running with one compact close encounter, then immediately complete a visible foot-to-faster-carrier handoff while preserving the established travel axis. Hold sustained acceleration on that axis; the source does not prove that the encounter creates the carrier or that pursuer distance increases on screen.

invariants.rule: Establish one readable pursuit axis before any combat.
invariants.purpose: Gives every later move a direction and stakes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Action without geography becomes visual noise.

invariants.rule: Use one narrow threshold to compress the lead and threat.
invariants.purpose: Creates a spatial reason for the encounter.
invariants.ablation_failure: An arbitrary fight feels detached from the chase.

invariants.rule: Limit the close encounter to one clear block, counter and release.
invariants.ablation_failure: A long fight replaces the escape mechanism.

invariants.rule: Complete an immediate, visible foot-to-faster-carrier handoff after the encounter.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the chase continuous while changing the movement regime.
invariants.ablation_failure: A delayed or disconnected carrier cut breaks the pursuit handoff.

invariants.rule: End with sustained carrier acceleration along the established travel direction.
invariants.purpose: Makes the new speed regime visible without inventing a measured gap.
invariants.ablation_failure: A stationary carrier beauty shot does not complete the escape progression.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source wet neon street and parking garage
source motorcycle theft and exact fight choreography
